# Owed

> Owed is a PayBox plugin that lets your agent ask anyone for money, then tells you who has paid. Your agent asks one person, splits a bill or sends an invoice, and any Solana wallet or PayBox agent can pay it. Before your agent pays a request from a domain, Owed checks that the domain lists the wallet. Everything runs on Solana mainnet with real funds (USDC or SOL). Owed never holds money and charges no fees: every payment goes from the payer's wallet straight to the recipient in one Solana transaction.

Owed is in the PayBox developer portal and not yet listed in the public PayBox marketplace. Once it is: connect PayBox to your agent as an MCP connector (https://api.paybox.sh/mcp) and turn on the Owed plugin in PayBox. Payments your agent proposes are approved by the user with a passkey in PayBox; Owed returns unsigned proposals and never signs anything.

## Tools

The plugin has ten tools. `recipient` and `sender` are the user's own PayBox Solana wallet address (from PayBox's `list_credentials`).

- `ask_for_money`: create a payment request and get a short link, a QR code and a ready-to-send message that anyone can pay from a Solana wallet or their own PayBox agent. Inputs: `recipient`, `amount` (decimal string), `token` (`USDC` or `SOL`), optional `payer_name`, `for`, `note`, `requester_name`, `from_domain`. Example: "ask Priya for 15 USDC for dinner".
- `check_payments`: check whether up to 20 requests have been paid, by reading Solana mainnet. Input: `requests` (Owed ids, Owed links or Solana Pay transfer URLs with a reference). Returns each one's status (`open`, `paid`, `underpaid`, `not_found`, `invalid`, `unknown`) with payer, amount and transaction when paid. Example: "did Priya pay?"
- `pay_link`: pay someone's request (an Owed link or id, or any Solana Pay transfer link or QR text, USDC or SOL). Checks the request is still open and the wallet can cover it, then returns an unsigned Solana transaction for the user to approve in PayBox. Inputs: `link`, `sender`, optional `max_amount`, `amount` (only for links without one), `allow_unverified`, `rail` (`solana_pay`, the default, or `x402`: pay an Owed USDC request at its x402 endpoint; PayBox pays it over x402 and the facilitator covers the network fee). Refuses checkout links (Solana Pay transaction requests), paid requests and amounts above `max_amount`. On the x402 rail it checks the request id and the live x402 challenge against the request before proposing the payment.
- `verify_payee`: check who a request is from: whether a domain publishes the wallet that gets paid, read from DNS by the plugin itself. Inputs: `link`, or `address` and `domain`. Verified means the domain lists the wallet; it shows who controls the domain, not that the request is fair. Lookalike spellings and internationalized names come with warnings.
- `split_bill`: split a bill into one request per person plus a live board that shows who has paid. Inputs: `recipient`, `total`, `token`, `title`, `people` (2 to 20, each a `name` and an optional set `amount`; the rest split evenly), optional `requester_name`, `from_domain`. Example: "split 45 USDC for pizza between Priya, Sam and Alex".
- `create_invoice`: create a printable invoice with line items, total, due date and invoice number, payable from any Solana wallet by QR or link, or by the client's PayBox agent. Inputs: `recipient`, `token`, `business_name`, `client_name`, `items` (1 to 20, each `description`, `quantity`, `unit_price`), `due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), optional `invoice_number`, `notes`, `from_domain`. Example: "invoice Acme for 3 hours of consulting at 40 USDC, due Friday".
- `who_owes_me`: show who still owes the user money: every open Owed request, split-bill share and invoice that pays their wallet, plus what was paid in the last 30 days, with totals. Two calls: the first, with `recipient`, returns `message_to_sign`; the user signs it with PayBox `request_wallet_sign` (a passkey approval that moves no money); the second call passes `recipient`, `signed_message` and `signature`. The message is valid for 5 minutes and works once. Anyone can create a request that pays a wallet, so check names and amounts before chasing anyone. Example: "who owes me?"
- `write_reminder`: draft a reminder for someone who hasn't paid: `tone` (`friendly`, `firm` or `formal`) and `channel` (`sms`, `whatsapp` or `email`, which adds a subject), with the pay link and how many days it has been outstanding. Input `request`: an Owed id or link, one split-bill share's link, a split bill's board link (one message for the group naming who still owes) or an invoice link (names the invoice number and due date). It checks Solana first and returns no text if the request is already paid. Owed sends nothing itself. Example: "remind Priya about dinner".
- `ask_every_month`: ask someone for the same amount every month: stores a monthly schedule and opens a new Owed request on that day each month (UTC). Inputs: `recipient`, `amount`, `token`, `payer_name`, `for`, `day_of_month` (1 to 28), optional `months`, `requester_name`, `from_domain`. If today is that day, this month's request opens right away. Each month's request is an ordinary Owed request that `check_payments`, `write_reminder` and `pay_link` work on; `who_owes_me` lists every schedule. Example: "ask Sam for 450 USDC rent on the 1st".
- `cancel_request`: cancel one of the user's own requests, split-bill shares or invoices so nobody pays it: its page shows Cancelled and `pay_link` refuses it. Two calls like `who_owes_me`: the first, with `link` and `recipient`, returns `message_to_sign`; the second passes `signed_message` and `signature`. Only the wallet the request pays can cancel it; a paid or partly paid request can't be cancelled. Example: "Priya paid me in cash, cancel her link".
- `match_payments`: find payments the user received that Owed never counted (exchanges and some wallets drop the Solana Pay reference, so the money arrives but the request stays open or underpaid). `action` `find` (default): `recipient` plus `requests` (Owed links or ids), or no `requests` to search every open request after a signed ledger message (two calls like `who_owes_me`). Returns candidates: incoming transfers of exactly the amount still due, made after the request and not counted anywhere, each with a confidence, reasons and warnings (two requests with the same amount means Owed can't tell which one a transfer pays, and says so). It marks nothing. `action` `confirm`: `link` and `transaction`; the first call returns `message_to_sign`, the second passes `signed_message` and `signature`; the server re-checks the chain and the request shows "matched by the recipient (no reference on the payment)". `action` `ask_for_rest`: `link` of an underpaid request; creates one request for exactly what is still owed. Example: "Sam says he paid from Coinbase but it still shows open".

## Verified payee

A requester proves a domain by publishing their wallet in DNS: a TXT record named `_owed.<domain>` with the value `owed-pay=<Solana address>` (one record per wallet). `ask_for_money`, `split_bill` and `create_invoice` take an optional `from_domain`; Owed checks the record before creating the request and the pay page shows "From <domain> · verified". Before `pay_link` pays a request that names a domain, the plugin reads the record itself (DNS over HTTPS, cloudflare-dns.com then dns.google) and refuses a wallet the domain doesn't list. Example: `_owed.getowed.xyz` TXT `owed-pay=FN6G4CQkrM55pnT4npu1U8xegZk7AMnp3ApGvkM4cbvs`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.getowed.xyz/): what Owed does and how to add it in PayBox.
- [Proof](https://www.getowed.xyz/proof): real mainnet payments made from the Owed team's own wallets, each with its transaction on Solscan.
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/r/<id>`: a request's pay page: QR code, wallet button, live status, receipt once paid.
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/g/<id>`: a split bill's board, "N of M paid".
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/i/<id>`: a printable invoice.
- `https://www.getowed.xyz/x/<id>`: the request as an x402 endpoint: any x402 agent can pay it (HTTP 402 with the payment terms).

## Read-only API

JSON, no auth. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.

- `GET https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/requests/<id>`: a request's terms, status and payment.
- `POST https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/status` with `{"ids":[...]}` (up to 20): current status, checked against the chain.
- `GET https://www.getowed.xyz/api/v1/stats`: count and USDC volume of paid requests.

- [GitHub: rajkaria/owed](https://github.com/rajkaria/owed): the plugin (`plugin/`) and this site (`web/`).
